title: Holiness
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child says that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit (1 Corinthians 6:19-20) and gives ways to honour God with it: clean words, good places, kind hands, keeping away from what leads to sin.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the Holy Spirit helps a Christian.
floor.question: Name one work of the Holy Spirit.

representations: a picture of a clean church building
steps: The temple here is your body.
Name ways to honour God with hands, mouth, feet.
Keep away from places that lead to sin.
contexts: a place where older boys smoke

board.do: Draw a body outline and write "temple" across it.

board.say: How can you honour God with your mouth?

board.do: Wait for the child to say kind, true words.
Write good uses beside the hands and feet too.

listen_for: It is mine, to do what I want
misconceptions.ask: What does 1 Corinthians 6:19-20 say about your body?
misconceptions.repair: Read the verse and the words "you are not your own".

misconceptions.ask: In 1 Corinthians 6:19, what is the temple?
misconceptions.repair: Read the verse again: "your bodies are temples".

misconceptions.ask: Your friends go to a place where children smoke. What is wise?
Which of these honours God with your body?
misconceptions.repair: Make a body outline and write good uses beside each part: hands to help, mouth to speak kindly, feet to go to good places.

checks.question: In 1 Corinthians 6:19, what is the temple of the Holy Spirit?
Your friends go where children smoke. What is wise?
